lotExposureStartFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound of lot exposure start: an ISO-8601 date (start of that UTC day), e.g. 2024-09-01, or a date-time with offset, e.g. 2024-09-01T06:00:00Z.

lotExposureStartTo.description: Inclusive upper bound of lot exposure start: an ISO-8601 date (whole UTC day included), e.g. 2024-09-17, or a date-time with offset. Omit or null for no upper bound.

productIds.description: Product ids. Empty means all products; a null element also matches a missing product id.

layerIds.description: Key layer ids. Empty means all layers; a null element also matches a missing layer id.

exposureEquipmentIds.description: Exposure scanner ids, e.g. GW021. Empty means all scanners; a null element also matches a missing id.

lotIds.description: Key lot ids. Empty means all lots; a null element also matches a missing lot id.

chuckIds.description: Wafer stage chuck ids, e.g. Chuck1. Empty means all chucks; a null element also matches a missing chuck id.
